title: Calls & Agents (live 24 h) · RabbitMQ
description: Calls handled per user/agent from Kazoo CDRs (callstats exporter): rolling 24 h or today, by result, plus RabbitMQ queue health.

panels.title: Total calls
panels.description: Every call leg of a user/agent in the window, any result.

panels.title: Answered
panels.description: Connected and billed (talk time > 0), ended normally.

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Caller hung up before it was answered (ORIGINATOR_CANCEL).

panels.title: No answer
panels.description: Rang out / no response, or ended normally before anyone answered.

panels.title: Busy / rejected
panels.description: USER_BUSY or CALL_REJECTED.

panels.title: Dropped
panels.description: Answered, then ended abnormally (media timeout, network error, ...).

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Never connected: unallocated number, temporary failure, no route, ...

panels.title: Answer rate
panels.description: Answered / all legs (legs answered on another phone of the same ring group are left out).

panels.title: Talk time
panels.description: Billed seconds of all answered legs.

panels.title: Active agents
panels.description: Users with at least one call leg in the window.

panels.title: Calls last 15 min
panels.description: From the live counter (counts since the exporter started).

panels.title: Calls per 15 min by result
panels.description: Live counter since the exporter started; the 24 h totals above come from the CDRs themselves.

panels.title: Calls per agent
panels.description: One row per user. Incoming = calls that rang the agent's phone; outgoing = calls the agent placed. Click a column header to sort.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (user, extension) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="answered"}) / sum by (user, extension) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status!="answered_elsewhere"})

panels.title: Top 15 agents by calls, split by result ($window)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="answered"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="cancelled"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="no_answer"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="unanswered"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="busy"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="rejected"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="dropped"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="failed"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent",status="answered_elsewhere"} and on (user) topk(15, sum by (user) (kazoo_user_calls_window{cluster="$cluster",account=~"$account",window="$window",call_type=~"$call_type",user=~"$agent"})))

panels.title: Calls per 15 min — top 10 agents
panels.description: Pick agents in the Agent filter to compare specific people.

panels.title: All call legs (users, trunks, IVR) by result
panels.description: Every CDR leg of the account, including carrier/trunk legs that have no user. A call between two parties has 2+ legs.

panels.title: Messages ready
panels.description: Waiting for a consumer, all queues. Normal is 0.

panels.title: Unacked
panels.description: Delivered, not yet acknowledged.

panels.title: Stuck queues
panels.description: Queues holding messages with no consumer: nothing will read them.

panels.title: Queues without consumer
panels.description: Empty ones are usually harmless leftovers.

panels.title: Connections / consumers
panels.description: AMQP connections (the consumer count is in the families table).

panels.title: Queue families
panels.description: Queues grouped by name pattern (<pid>, <id>, <uuid> replace the per-connection parts).
